representation_fit.evidence: Brief shape is relational-web (understand × 关系结构, 依赖与影响可跟随). Implementation is a directed dependency graph of 28 nodes / 55 edges with arrows pointing to the depended-on party (screenshot 1280x860 header; source/js/data.js:46-102), and relationship-following is the core mechanic: directional BFS up/down (source/js/graph.js:32-56), hop closures (graph.js:59-65), concrete path extraction (graph.js:68-90), edge strength core/std (data.js:47-101). Own test receipt confirms followability ≥3 hops with monotonic closure (source/evidence-test-log.txt:12-15, 21 passed 0 failed).

primary_task_salience.evidence: The relation web canvas occupies ~70% of the initial screen in both screenshots (1280x860, 1440x900); the header subtitle states the success criterion verbatim 「关系跟随不丢失全局上下文 · 28 节点 · 55 关系 · 箭头指向被依赖方」 (source/index.html:16); a permanent 跟随 breadcrumb bar (index.html:30-34) and legend explaining A→B semantics (index.html:48) sit on the first screen; inspector leads with a 3-step 选中→跟随→不迷路 guide (index.html:59-65).

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy: title + subtitle identify what/where within the first line (index.html:15-16); legend decodes the 6 node types with counts (screenshots bottom-left; app.js:121-137); arrow semantics and 顺向/逆向 trace meanings are explained in one sentence (index.html:48); the right panel gives an explicit numbered how-to (index.html:62-64). No loading state — all content rendered synchronously at startup (app.js:581-591).

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object (the relation web) is fully visible with zero navigation on load (both screenshots, fit-view at app.js:589). Reaching a relationship is 2 interactions: click node (app.js:111) then 追踪上游依赖/追踪下游影响 (app.js:455-461); search narrows to any node in one Enter (app.js:517-523); minimap click re-centers (app.js:205-213); single screen, no routes or modes (index.html:36-70).

context_loss.evidence: Directly addresses the acceptance seed: global graph is dimmed but never hidden during tracing — app.js:2-3 states the constraint, style.css:145 (.edge.dim opacity .13) and style.css:169 (.node.dim opacity .15); minimap always visible and highlights trace range + viewport (app.js:222-249, index.html:52 「全图始终可见」); breadcrumb records every hop as clickable return chips (app.js:316-344); per-node distance badges (app.js:289-295); deterministic layout keeps positions stable (graph.js:97-186, log line 16 布局确定性).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent chrome is minimal and each surface maps to a brief need: search (28-node locate), 3 view buttons (dense-canvas zoom/fit, index.html:23-27), breadcrumb bar (follow context), legend (6-type decode), minimap (global-context seed), inspector that stays instruction-only until selection (index.html:57-69). No tabs, settings, or redundant modes in source or screenshots.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails all three a11y checks: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, a11y.target_size=fail (measurement-summary.json checks). Offending patterns visible in source: --faint #8b94a8 small text at 10.5-11px (style.css:10,173,217,230), light strokes #c4ccdd on white (style.css:143), breadcrumb chips ~22px tall (style.css:111-114), 8px legend dots (style.css:290). Mitigations exist — node tabindex+role=button with Enter/Space (app.js:88-91,112-114), aria listbox (index.html:20-21), aria-live status (index.html:33), focus-visible outlines (style.css:96,116,245,268) — but the measured outcomes are failing, hence 2 not higher.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects: layout.overflow=pass, layout.responsive_collision=pass, text.truncation=pass, and both screenshots (1280x860, 1440x900) render cleanly with no clipping or collision. However 4/7 checks failed (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size — measurement-summary.json), implying remediation passes (contrast fixes, larger targets, projected font sizes) would be required: rework-inducing defects without visible breakage.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed 「关系跟随不丢失全局上下文」 is covered at three levels: (1) stated as the product subtitle (index.html:16) and guide step 3 不迷路 (index.html:64); (2) implemented via dim-not-hide rendering, always-on minimap with trace-range marker, clickable hop breadcrumbs, distance badges (app.js:2-3,222-344; style.css:145,169); (3) verified by unit evidence — upstream/downstream follow ≥3 hops, concrete paths, monotonic closures, deterministic layout (source/evidence-test-log.txt:5-16,21). URL state reproduces any trace (app.js:559-578).

defects_observed: a11y.contrast fail — faint small text (#8b94a8 at 10.5-11px, style.css:173,217,230) and light edge strokes (#c4ccdd, style.css:143) per measurement-summary.json
a11y.focus_order fail per measurement-summary.json — canvas has 28 tab stops but no arrow-key traversal between nodes (app.js:112-114 only Enter/Space)
a11y.target_size fail per measurement-summary.json — breadcrumb chips ~22px high (style.css:111-114), dist badge 18px circle (app.js:104), 8px legend dots (style.css:290)
type.min_projected_size fail per measurement-summary.json — 10.5px node-sub and 11px meta/hint text (style.css:173,217,230) fall below projected minimum at review viewports
Moderate edge-crossing density in mid layers of the initial layout (both screenshots), partially mitigated by 4-round barycenter ordering (graph.js:134-153)
scores.overall_note: The package is a single-screen, statically loadable relation-web explorer whose primary representation (directed dependency graph with directional BFS tracing, hop closures, concrete paths, and edge strength) matches the brief's understand×relational-web shape and its 依赖与影响可跟随 success criterion almost exactly; the initial screen makes the relation web dominant, self-explanatory (header semantics, legend, 3-step guide), and reachable with zero navigation. The acceptance seed is not merely claimed but engineered (dim-not-hide global view, persistent minimap marking trace range and viewport, per-hop clickable breadcrumbs, deterministic layout) and backed by a 21/0-passing self-test log covering multi-hop upstream/downstream followability. The clear weakness is accessibility: all three receipt a11y checks fail (contrast, focus order, target size) plus type.min_projected_size, driven by faint 10.5-11px text, light strokes, and sub-24px targets, which is what keeps frontend_rework at mid-scale despite clean layout/responsive/truncation results; layout quality itself shows no visible defects at either viewport. Per the rubric, task time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable here, and this model-judged review is not a human preference verdict.
